result.guidanceOfficial: year is expected to be 880 萬美元 across all divisions. Weak demand in the Cable TV scatter market shifted more inventory to the direct response category at lower rates in the third quarter. We saw an increase in local digital revenue in our radio markets, but large client attrition and suppressed rates in national direct digital revenue meant significant revenue declines in the overall digital segment. Revised Adjusted EBITDA (2) guide for 2026 is now 4,000 萬美元 given the realities of the current advertising marketplace. Management is hyper-focused on cost reductions heading into next year and has identified at least 2,000 萬美元 of annualized savings.
